addresspress.shortDescription: Address label maker and envelope printer for Windows. Print addresses on envelopes and label sheets from your own address book – free, offline and private, with no print limits.
addresspress.description:
Address label maker and envelope printer for Windows: print addresses straight onto envelopes or sheets of sticky mailing labels from your own address book.
Perfect for holiday cards, wedding invitations, thank-you notes, small business mail and return address labels – with no print limits, even in the free version.

Type your addresses once, tick who gets a letter and print. AddressPress places every address neatly on the envelope or label, splits long lines and makes the text smaller only when it must, so everything fits.

What you can print – FREE:
• Envelopes in No. 10, A7, DL, C5 and C6 sizes, with or without your return address
• Label sheets: US Letter with 30, 20, 14, 10, 6 or 80 labels and A4 with 21, 14 or 24 labels per sheet
• A full sheet of your own return address labels
• A test page to check that the print lines up with your labels
• "Start at label no." to use up half-used sheets
• Fine adjustment in millimetres if your printer prints a little off-centre
• Up to 10 addresses in your address book, saved as a CSV backup any time

AddressPress Pro – one-time purchase, no subscription:
• Unlimited addresses in your address book
• Import from Excel (.xlsx), CSV or the clipboard – bring your list from a spreadsheet or your email contacts; columns are matched for you and duplicates are skipped
• Your own envelope size in millimetres

Private and offline
AddressPress works without internet (only reading Excel files needs a connection; CSV works offline). There is no account and no upload: your address book stays on your PC. Printing is never limited and never watermarked.

Tip: print one envelope or a test page on plain paper first – every printer feeds envelopes a little differently. In the Windows print window choose the same paper size and Scale 100%.
features: Print addresses on envelopes: No. 10, A7, DL, C5 and C6, with an optional return address
Print mailing label sheets in common US Letter and A4 sizes, including return address labels
Test page and millimetre adjustment so the print lines up exactly with your labels
Start at any label to use up half-used sheets – no wasted labels

budgetpress.shortDescription: Budget app and budget planner for Windows with envelope budgeting: give every dollar a job, track spending and plan debt payoff. Private, offline, no subscription, no bank login.
budgetpress.description:
Budget app and budget planner for Windows that uses envelope budgeting – a zero-based budget where you give every dollar a job.
Track spending, cover overspending, pay off credit cards and see your debt-free date – without a subscription, an account or a bank login.

How it works: add your checking, savings and cash, then assign that money to envelopes such as rent, groceries and fun until Ready to Assign reaches zero. Record what you spend and every envelope shows what is left. Unused money rolls over to next month.

• Envelope budget with Ready to Assign, roll-over, move money and cover overspending
• Up to 3 accounts, plus credit card payment envelopes that fill up automatically
• Transactions with splits, transfers, flags, cleared marks and reconcile
• Payees remember their category; undo with Ctrl+Z
• Spending by category report
• Printable cash envelopes with a spending log – made for cash stuffing
• PIN lock and backup file

BudgetPress Pro – one-time purchase, no subscription, ever:

dupesweep.shortDescription: Duplicate file finder for Windows: find and remove duplicate files and similar photos on any folder or drive to free up disk space. Safe, private, offline, no subscription.
dupesweep.description:
Duplicate file finder and duplicate photo finder for Windows: scan any folder or drive, find files stored more than once and remove the extras to free up disk space.
Photos copied from your phone twice, downloads saved again, backups of backups – DupeSweep finds them, shows every copy side by side and keeps one safe.

Files are compared by their contents – a SHA-256 fingerprint of every byte – not by name – so "IMG_0042 (1).jpg" and "Beach.jpg" are matched only if they really are the same.

FREE:

• Find every exact duplicate of any file type: photos, videos, music, documents and archives
• Preview photos, videos, music and PDFs before you decide
• Auto-select: keep the newest or oldest copy
• Warning before you remove every copy of a file
• Safe review folder: move extras into a dated folder instead of deleting them
• Large files list (the 200 biggest) and empty folders list
• Clean up to 25 files per scan

DupeSweep Pro – one-time purchase, no subscription:
• Unlimited cleaning
• All similar photo groups – resized copies, edits, re-saved pictures and burst shots (free shows the first 2 groups)
• Smart auto-select: keep the shortest or longest path, the largest file or the copy in a folder you choose
• Empty folder cleanup
• Export a report (.csv)

Try every Pro feature free for 7 days.

Private and offline
No account and no upload. Your photos and documents never leave your PC. Cleaning history shows everything that was moved or deleted.
